scope: Broaden the 3D implementation plan from ACIS/B-rep qualification to explicit DXF MESH, legacy POLYLINE mesh, and polyface semantics; distinguish wire/topology fidelity, subdivision evaluation, and closed-solid validation.

method.kind: Primary Autodesk DXF references, upstream mesh-library documentation, and read-only local source/test cross-check
method.evidenceBoundary: Autodesk defines DXF entity framing and field semantics. Peer-library docs establish only those projects' stated topology assumptions and conversion limits; no peer runtime or native consumer was tested. Local source inspection was against the existing dirty worktree and is not an independent build/test result. ODA v5.4.1 remains authoritative for DWG byte layouts.

evidence.topic: Subdivision MESH, classic POLYLINE mesh, and polyface are distinct representations
observed: Autodesk defines MESH/AcDbSubDMesh using a subdivision level, level-0 vertices, face-list, edges, crease values, and sub-entity property overrides.
Autodesk defines legacy POLYLINE mesh and polyface through POLYLINE mode flags and child VERTEX records; polyface face records are limited to four indices and use signed indices for edge visibility.

ezdxf documents n-gons for MESH but only triangles/quadrilaterals for polyface; its conversion helpers triangulate MESH n-gons for polyface/3DFACE and warn that concave n-gons may not convert correctly.
doesNotEstablish: that every n-gon is planar or that triangulation preserves a non-planar face's geometry
evaluated subdivision-surface geometry from the stored level-0 cage
DWG AcDbSubDMesh byte layout or valid older-version acceptance
evidence.planUse: Do not use POLYLINE/polyface or 3DFACE tessellation as a silent MESH fallback. Keep native record identity, cage topology, crease/override fields, and any derived tessellation as separately reported outcomes.

evidence.topic: A valid mesh record does not imply a closed or manifold solid
observed: CGAL's polygon-mesh documentation allows boundaries and describes its polygon mesh algorithms as operating on a 2-manifold topology; its listed geometry checks include self-intersection, orientation, connected components, area, and volume operations.
The Manifold library describes a manifold triangle mesh as a solid representation, reports an error for imported non-manifold meshes, and separately documents repair/merge capabilities.
The available independent kernels therefore have input-domain preconditions that are narrower than a DXF MESH or polyface codec's obligation to retain its supplied control topology.
doesNotEstablish: that arbitrary DXF MESH input is a solid, closed, manifold, oriented, or non-self-intersecting
that a repair, winding correction, triangulation, or successful kernel import preserves source topology
an independent DWG/DXF parser or ACIS/B-rep validation route
evidence.planUse: Keep parser/writer topology fidelity separate from optional geometry-kernel results. Run volume checks only for controls whose independently authored expected model is explicitly a closed solid; preserve repair/fallback status and reject repaired output as proof of lossless input topology.

evidence.topic: Current local MESH implementation boundary and least-cost next validation
observed: The local DRW_Mesh model carries base-cage vertices/faces/edges, crease values, and DXF property-override metadata; the DXF writer emits the documented field families and version-specific MESH/SUBDIVISION record profile.
The local DWG encoder emits only the base-cage layout and rejects nonempty propertyOverrides because no verified DWG mapping is available; this remains an intentional fail-closed boundary.

The existing generated DXF wire test checks raw schema plus typed readback for a small triangle control, but no test or runtime was run during this research pass and this does not independently validate evaluated subdivision geometry or a closed volume.
evidence.planUse: Extend existing fast owners with generated controls that distinguish an open boundary surface, an n-gon/base cage, and a closed analytic mesh; assert record identity, exact indices/order, creases/overrides, and source-to-output disposition. Keep volume/topology-kernel use optional and composed-gate-only. Do not alter the DWG fail-closed override policy absent authoritative layout evidence.

refinesExistingOwners: S2/S3 MESH and DWG custom-class evidence gates
S8 consumer and independent semantic qualification
PAR-07 peer admission and evidence normalization
fastLocalSequence: Keep touched-target ASCII/binary wire and typed-readback tests as the per-slice gate; no new external tool is required.

Within the existing MESH/polyface test owner, use runtime-generated controls for open-surface, n-gon, and closed-simplex/cube cases; assert literal wire fields and typed topology before any projection.

For a closed generated control only, compare independently authored bounds/area/volume and closedness. An optional pinned Manifold or CGAL run belongs only at the composed checkpoint and must report rejects, repairs, orientation changes, and omissions.
Keep MESH subdivision evaluation, DWG MESH encoding, ACIS/B-rep semantics, and native application acceptance as later independent rows; no fallback representation may promote another row.

planDelta.validation: Receipt JSON validation and git diff whitespace validation only; no local tests or build were run for this research-only update.
